planted_findings.name: Missing audit reason column (21 CFR Part 11)

rows.title: Modularity (Newman Q)
rows.definition: Newman modularity of the partition on the weighted call graph.

rows.title: Inter-cluster call ratio
rows.definition: Share of call weight that crosses a cluster boundary.

rows.title: Structural modularity
rows.definition: Mean intra-cluster cohesion minus mean inter-cluster coupling.

rows.title: Cohesion
rows.definition: Mean intra-cluster similarity from the S matrix.

rows.title: Coupling
rows.definition: Share of call weight crossing boundaries (objective term).

rows.title: Blast radius
rows.definition: Per PRD 11.3, normalised by class count: size of every HIGH-tier cluster plus the clusters calling into it.

rows.title: Re-validation scope
rows.definition: Percentage of components that a change to the validated core drags into full re-validation: everything inside a cluster holding a HIGH-tier component, plus every cluster that calls into one. Classes a clusterer left unplaced count as single-class units.

rows.title: Clusters holding the validated core
rows.definition: Clusters containing at least one HIGH-tier component.

rows.title: Largest cluster
rows.definition: Class count of the biggest proposed service.

rows.title: Mixed-criticality clusters
rows.definition: Clusters that mix HIGH-tier and LOW-tier components, so a utility change re-validates the core.

rows.title: Tables written by two clusters
rows.definition: Regulated tables with writers in more than one cluster - each one blocks independent deployment.
